snippet.title: They Told Us AI Would Solve Everything | Future Sauce Dispenser Trailer
snippet.description:
They told us AI would solve everything.

Nobody asked whether we should stop thinking.

Future Sauce Dispenser is a satirical game about automation, dependence, and the systems we trust simply because they work most of the time.

No sauce.
No function.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4573480/Future_Sauce_Dispenser

#gaming #ai #future
